findings.claim: The mounted case HTTP routes do not enforce the required case capabilities before executing reads or mutations.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion/spec says callers that lack the capability required by the operation must be refused; `clinical_context(&state, &headers, query.practice_id)` returns `(context, _)` and every handler discards capabilities, then directly calls `state.services.create_case/list_cases/read_case/update_case/transition_case`.
findings.suggested_fix: Use the capabilities returned by `clinical_context` in each handler and require `case:read` for reads and `case_write` for create/update/transition/command reconciliation before calling AppServices.

findings.claim: The shell-neutral case service authorizes every human user without checking operation-specific case capabilities.
findings.evidence: `check_case_context` only rejects expired sessions and non-`Principal::User`, while the spec requires refusal when a caller "lacks the capability required by this operation".
findings.suggested_fix: Carry verified capabilities into the service boundary or add an authority/capability port check for `case:read` and `case_write` before delegating to the repository.

findings.claim: The migration uses the PostgreSQL 17 `MAINTAIN` privilege unconditionally, which can fail on older supported PostgreSQL versions.
findings.evidence: The migration calls `pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(..., 'SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE, REFERENCES, TRIGGER, MAINTAIN')`, while the Rust role checks in `crates/aso-web-server/src/adapters/gate.rs` explicitly guard `MAINTAIN` with `current_setting('server_version_num')::integer >= 170000`, showing compatibility is expected.
findings.suggested_fix: Split the `MAINTAIN` check behind a server-version guard in the migration, matching the Rust `ROLE_CHECK`/`CASE_ROLE_CHECK` pattern.

findings.claim: The existing `/api/cases/{case_id}/evidence` evidence-count route is removed from this router without an equivalent replacement in the shown diff.
findings.evidence: The deleted code routed `Router::new().route("/api/cases/{case_id}/evidence", get(evidence_counts))` and serialized distinct `met`, `gap`, and `void` counts; the new router only mounts `/api/cases`, `/api/cases/{case_id}`, `/api/cases/{case_id}/status`, and command lookup routes, while the blocking constraint requires preserving three evidence states.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the evidence-count route or show/move an equivalent mounted route that still returns distinct `met`, `gap`, and `void` values.
